messages:
Aisha: Quick sync — final version of the micro-brief for the enterprise launch is ready for routing validation. Doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/d/1AbCxyz (please use the latest 'routing-ready' comment thread)
Gabe: On it. My two asks: clean inbound lead routing flow for regulated buyers (soops: qualify -> SLA tier -> sales queue) and a crisp webinar CTA that drives signups, not just watchers.
Priya: I'll tighten the SLA bullets. Suggest we collapse technical detail to one line + link to appendix so field doesn't get overloaded.
Marta: For govcloud and on-prem prospects we need explicit routing tags. Proposed rules below, can someone sanity-check?
```
if org.region == "US-Gov": route->sales-gov
elif org.deployment == "onprem": route->solutions-onprem
elif company.size >= 1000 and wants-dedicated: route->solutions-dedicated
else: route->sales-enterprise
```
Gabe: Nice. Also want a 1-line benchmark blurb for the brief: "Redwood Dedicated reduced median latency by ~35% vs generic managed endpoints on high-concurrency workloads" — Priya, can you confirm numbers and add citation?
Priya: Confirmed the median and 95th p latency numbers from internal-bench-2026.pdf. I'll add a parenthetical citation and link to the appendix.
MarketingBot: :spiral_note_pad: New asset submitted: micro-brief-enterprise-v1 for review by marketing@redwood.ai
Aisha: Can someone own the final PDF export + gated download (SSO gated) and S3 upload? Prefer we keep control plane download gated for enterprise leads. @Marta?
Marta: I can handle export and upload today. Will also create S3 presigned URL and set the IAM policy for audit.
Gabe: I'll sign off on the webinar CTA copy. Proposed copy: "Join our field session: Secure, predictable LLM inference — deploy modes & SLAs explained." Keep 1 CTA (Register) + secondary (Request demo).
Priya: CTA looks good. I'll shorten the benchmark blurb to ~24 words to fit the one-pager margin.
Marta: Uploaded draft to staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/briefs/micro-brief-enterprise-v1 — check the routing table and CTA placement.
Docs-Bot: Deployed brief to marketing staging (build 482).
Aisha: Thanks — target publish Monday 09:00 PT. Last open items: translations (skip for initial launch), legal copy review (I've looped in counsel via the doc comments), and inbound lead routing test. Gabe can you trigger a QA run on routing rules with sample payloads?
Gabe: Will run QA on routing with sample payloads and post results by EOD. :thumbsup:
Marta: I'll attach the S3 link and update the gated form to add the routing tag mapping field.
Aisha: Great — if QA passes, we'll flip the staging asset to live Monday morning and queue the webinar invite sequence. Thanks team!
